protocol.claim_scope: synthetic multiplicity-controlled sparse typed interaction adaptation

conditions.global_reversal: all context hazards map to 0.12^2 / source hazard
conditions.subject_scene_xor_reversal: contexts reverse iff subject_type=cup XOR scene=busy

protocol.hierarchy: a pooled parent group is vetoed when finer typed cells have mixed discovery slope signs
protocol.inference: paired seed-cluster 20000-resample bootstrap and exact sign test
protocol.multiplicity_control: identity-disjoint discovery-third fit; predictive likelihood-ratio e-value on confirmation two-thirds; Bonferroni across all 12 global, main-effect, and pairwise candidate groups
protocol.noise: deterministic event-status flips on calibration only; clean test
protocol.split: outcome-independent group-id hash; nested calibration subsets; one fixed group-disjoint test
protocol.subgroups: generator truth partitions changed/stable test metrics only and is never available to fitting or model selection
